extension.custom-calendars.name: Calendar systems
extension.custom-calendars.description: Freely definable time reckonings per area: maintenance in the settings, picker and calendar values in the document. When disabled, the values remain plain text.
extension.command-placement.name: Command placement
extension.command-placement.description: Custom command buttons in the status bar, a hide list for default buttons, a user-defined section in the editor context menu and macros as command sequences.
extension.reminders.name: Reminders
extension.reminders.description: Announces due ⏰ anchors on task lines: dialog with done and snooze actions, optional system notification, reminder list in the sidebar.
extension.figures.name: Image sizes and captions
extension.figures.description: Size hints directly in the image syntax (`![Alt](image.png =300x200)`) and automatic captions: an image standing alone becomes a figure with the alt text as its caption.
extension.typography.name: Typography: subscript, superscript, underline
extension.typography.description: Subscript with `H~2~O`, superscript with `x^^2^^` and underline with `++text++`.
extension.attributes.name: Attributes: spans and heading IDs
extension.attributes.description: Inline spans `[text]{.class #id}` and custom heading IDs with `# Title {#my-id}`; only `id` and `class` are allowed.
extension.wiki-links.name: Wiki links
extension.wiki-links.description: Wiki links `[[target]]` with heading and block anchors, block anchors `^id`, plus the outgoing links and backlinks panels including the link index.
extension.graph-view.name: Graph view
extension.graph-view.description: Shows the link relations of Markdown files as an interactive graph: the area graph as its own tab, the file graph as a sidebar panel.
extension.focus-mode.name: Focus mode and typewriter scroll
extension.focus-mode.description: Focus mode hides the tab bar, status bar and sidebar for distraction-free writing; typewriter scroll keeps the cursor line vertically centered.
extension.sidebar-collapse.name: Collapse sidebar columns
extension.sidebar-collapse.description: Collapses the left or right sidebar column of each editor column as a whole and expands it again; the visibility of the individual panels is preserved.
extension.outliner.name: List structure
extension.outliner.description: Move list items together with their sub-items and indent or outdent whole branches; numbered lists are renumbered consecutively afterwards.
extension.tasks.name: Tasks
extension.tasks.description: Task markers for dates, priority and recurrence, automatic dates on status change and a global filter.
settings.extensions.title: Extensions
settings.extensions.intro: Enable or disable built-in extensions. Disabled syntax renders as plain text; related panels, menu entries and shortcuts are hidden. Settings and data are preserved.
extensions.external.trustMessage: The extension '{name}' (version {version}) is third-party code and runs without a technical safety layer (no sandbox).
extensions.external.trustDetail: Once activated, this code gets full access to your documents and the entire app. Only activate extensions from sources you trust. A version change requires a new confirmation.
extensions.external.removeMessage: The folder of the extension '{name}' will be permanently deleted.
settings.extensionsExternal.title: Extensions (external)
settings.extensionsExternal.intro: External extensions are third-party code and run without a sandbox. Newly detected packages start disabled; activating requires an explicit confirmation. Actions in this section take effect immediately, independent of Apply/OK.
settings.extensionsExternal.empty: No external extensions found. Packages are installed as folders with a manifest.json in the extensions directory.
settings.extensionsExternal.diagnose.hin: Messages from an extension appear in the developer tools console. They open for this window and close again with the same button.
extension.events.name: Events
extension.events.description: Embedded event management in the document and aggregation via frontmatter properties, with tiered time differences, milestones and yearly recurrence.
